flags.why: Máy điện denotes electrical machines generally, including motors and generators, rather than specifically a generator ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-m%C3%A1y%20%C4%91i%E1%BB%87n)).
flags.fix: electrical machine (such as a generator or electric motor)

flags.why: This form of mụn is regional Central and Southern usage ([regional dictionary](https://khungcuahep.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/09/T%E1%BB%AB-%C4%90i%E1%BB%83n-Ph%C6%B0%C6%A1ng-Ng%E1%BB%AF-Hu%E1%BA%BF-Tr%E1%BA%A7n-Ng%E1%BB%8Dc-B%E1%BA%A3o.pdf)).
The example defines the title instead of showing it in use.
flags.fix: Hoàng thái hậu cho gọi nhà vua vào cung. = The empress dowager summoned the king to the palace.

flags.why: Vẹn means intact or complete; in giữ vẹn lời thề, giữ supplies the meaning 'keep' ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-v%E1%BA%B9n)).
flags.fix: Remove this separate sense and merge it into sense 1.

flags.why: Sống vẹn lời thề is unnatural because vẹn does not itself mean to keep a vow.
flags.fix: Hai người giữ vẹn lời thề đến lúc già. = The two kept their vow into old age.
